items.title: Online Gaming Application Form -Question 34: Name contact person
items.description: The contact name is not correct. The name of the contact person must be the same as that of the portal administrator. Kindly change to the appointed contact person and resubmit the form.

items.title: Online Gaming Application Form -Question 36: Passport number
items.description: The contact person passport number must be the same as that of the portal administrator. Kindly fill the passport number and resubmit the form.

items.title: Online Gaming Application Form -Question 38: Address contact person
items.description: The contact person address is not correct. The address must be the same as that of the portal administrator. Kindly fill in full address and resubmit the form.

items.title: Online Gaming Application Form -Question 39: Email address not correct
items.description: The form has a different email address than that of the portal. The email address must be the same as that of the portal administrator. Kindly change the email address and resubmit the form.

items.title: Online Gaming Application Form -Declaration and data privacy: Name contact person
items.description: The name of the contact person is not correct. The name must be the same as that of the portal administrator. Kindly change the name and resubmit the form.

items.title: Online Gaming Application Form -Declaration and data privacy: Signature
items.description: The signature is not correct. The signature must be of the portal administrator. Kindly resign and resubmit the form.
